FAQs

Frequently
Asked Questions

What is your minimum order quantity for free delivery?

To qualify for free delivery, your order must meet the following conditions:

  • Minimum order of 1 full carton per product
  • Order total of at least $150

Orders that do not meet these requirements may incur a delivery fee, which will be advised upon quotation.

How are the meats delivered?

All our meats are delivered using our refrigerated trucks to ensure the cold chain is maintained and product quality is preserved from our facility to your doorstep.

We follow strict hygiene and temperature control standards throughout the delivery process.

How do I get a quotation?

Reach out to us via phone, whatsapp or our contact page. Kindly ensure you provide us with the following details, for us to give you a quote:

  1. Type of meat and specific cut(s)
  2. Total weight required (in kilograms)
  3. Any specific requirements (e.g. raw / processed / marinated / cooked, packaging format, etc.)
  4. Estimated average order volume over the next 6 months
  5. Contact person’s name, designation, and contact number
  6. Company name and full address
